Tommy Hilfiger Livonia Toiletry Case Sling Bag – Premium Organizer for Travel & Daily Use

The Tommy Hilfiger Livonia Toiletry Case Sling Bag is designed for travelers, professionals, and everyday users who value style, durability, and organized storage. Created with a spacious layout and premium materials, this unisex toiletry case delivers superior functionality while staying true to the iconic Tommy Hilfiger design philosophy. Whether you’re packing for a business trip, keeping your grooming essentials in one place, or organizing personal items on the go, this high-quality toiletry case ensures everything stays neat, secure, and easily accessible.

Crafted using durable heavy twill polyester, the offers excellent water-resistance, making it ideal for travel environments, washrooms, gyms, and outdoor activities. The material resists daily wear and tear, ensuring long-term performance without compromising on style. Its thoughtful structure includes a spacious main compartment, an internal slip-in pocket for smaller accessories, and a convenient front pocket that allows quick access to your essentials. This smart organizational design helps keep your grooming tools, skincare items, personal products, and travel accessories perfectly sorted.

With a lightweight build of just 140 grams, the toiletry case is easy to carry and comfortable to handle throughout your journey. The reinforced grab handle adds strength and convenience, making it effortless to carry, hang, or attach to your luggage. Its compact yet roomy dimensions—L 23.5cm x W 10cm x H 14.5cm—provide enough space for all your essentials while maintaining a sleek travel-friendly profile.

As a versatile unisex travel accessory, the doubles as a grooming kit, makeup pouch, shaving kit organizer, or travel utility pouch. It is perfect for business travelers, fitness enthusiasts, corporate gifting, and anyone who prefers premium branded utility bags. The stylish aesthetic, embossed branding, and high-function design combine to make it a reliable and fashionable addition to your travel gear.

For those searching for high-quality toiletry cases, branded travel pouches, or durable grooming organizers, this sling-style toiletry bag stands out as a perfect choice. Its blend of practical design, iconic style, and rugged durability ensures that your essentials remain protected and organized wherever you go.

Key Features

  • Premium unisex toiletry case designed for travel, office, gym, and daily use
  • Crafted from durable heavy twill polyester for long-lasting performance
  • Water-resistant finish protects essentials during travel and daily handling
  • Spacious main compartment ideal for grooming items, toiletries, and accessories
  • Internal slip-in pocket for neatly storing smaller essentials
  • Convenient front pocket for quick access to frequently used items
  • Lightweight and compact design weighing only 140 gm
  • Reinforced grab handle for easy carrying, hanging, and luggage attachment
  • Dimensions: 23.5cm (L) x 10cm (W) x 14.5cm (H)
  • Stylish Tommy Hilfiger branding suitable for unisex use

Why Choose?

If you’re looking for a reliable, stylish, and spacious toiletry organizer, this bag from Tommy Hilfiger delivers everything you need. The premium twill polyester construction ensures water-resistance and durability, while the smart internal layout offers ample space for grooming products, travel essentials, and personal items. Its lightweight structure makes it ideal for flights, road trips, office commutes, and gym routines.

The  is also a top choice for gifting. It works well as a corporate gift, employee welcome kit item, festive gifting option, or premium accessory for clients and teams. With branded utility bags gaining popularity in the travel accessory market, this toiletry case offers a perfect blend of style, utility, and premium brand value.

Whether you’re upgrading your travel kit, organizing your grooming essentials, or choosing a premium branded toiletry pouch, this toiletry case stands out as a functional and stylish choice. Its high-quality design and practical features make it a must-have accessory for modern travelers who expect both performance and elegance.
